say:4:1013101003:1.text: My helmet bumped into a tree branch. Let me adjust it...
say:4:1013101003:1.source_cn: 刚才有条树枝碰歪了我的翼冠。调整一下……

say:5:1013101004:1.text: There we go. Let's keep moving.

say:6:1013101005:2.text: You might as well turn into one of those birds, flying up to any shiny surface just to admire yourself.
say:6:1013101005:2.source_cn: 你干脆像求偶期的雀鸟那样，看到个反光水面就冲上去照镜子算了。

say:7:1013101006:2.source_cn: 那倒不必，维伦，多谢你的关心。

say:8:1013101007:2.text: ... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let me take the lead. I don't want to keep walking next to this vain man...
say:8:1013101007:2.male: ... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let me take the lead. I don't want to keep walking next to this vain man...
say:8:1013101007:2.female: ... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let me take the lead. I don't want to keep walking next to this vain man...

choice_prompt:9:1013101007.text: ... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let me take the lead. I don't want to keep walking next to this vain man...
choice_prompt:9:1013101007.source_cn: ……<style=stress><player_name></style>，让我走在最前面吧。帮我隔开那家伙，拜托了……
choice_prompt:9:1013101007.male: ... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let me take the lead. I don't want to keep walking next to this vain man...
choice_prompt:9:1013101007.female: ... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let me take the lead. I don't want to keep walking next to this vain man...

say:10:1013101008:2.text: Ahem... On second thought, you and knight Temesia are still the best for that job.
say:10:1013101008:2.source_cn: 呃……还是按照约定好的，引路就交给你和特弥希娅了。
say:10:1013101008:2.male: Ahem... On second thought, you and knight Temesia are still the best for that job.
say:10:1013101008:2.female: Ahem... On second thought, you and knight Temesia are still the best for that job.

choice:9:0:1.text: You brave enough to scout ahead?
choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 那你来负责追踪魔偶气息
choice:9:0:1.male: You brave enough to scout ahead?
choice:9:0:1.female: You brave enough to scout ahead?

choice:9:1:2.text: Then you can track the golems for us.
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 那你来负责调查魔偶踪迹
choice:9:1:2.male: Then you can track the golems for us.
choice:9:1:2.female: Then you can track the golems for us.

say:0:1013102001:0.source_cn: 止步。这里存在一些特殊的痕迹。

say:1:1013102002:0.text: These marks look sort of odd.
say:1:1013102002:0.source_cn: 这个痕迹……似乎有点怪异？

say:2:1013102003:0.text: Seems like footprints left behind by the golems!
say:2:1013102003:0.source_cn: 看起来是魔偶移动的痕迹……
say:2:1013102003:0.male: Seems like footprints left behind by the golems!
say:2:1013102003:0.female: Seems like footprints left behind by the golems!

say:0:1013103001:0.text: Ah, don't come any closer! I... I...

say:1:1013103002:0.text: Help! Can anyone hear us? Someone, please help!
say:1:1013103002:0.source_cn: 救命啊！有没有人来，救救我们！

say:0:1013104001:0.text: Thank you, honorable magister and knights!
say:0:1013104001:0.source_cn: 感谢你们！尊贵的魔法师和骑士阁下们！
say:0:1013104001:0.male: Thank you, honorable magister and knights!
say:0:1013104001:0.female: Thank you, honorable magister and knights!

say:1:1013104002:0.text: Phew, let's move on. Be careful on the road ahead.
say:1:1013104002:0.source_cn: 呼，我们先离开了。后面的路途……请小心。

say:0:1013105001:0.text: There are some golems ahead, hidden by the rocks.
say:0:1013105001:0.source_cn: 前方那片营地——虽有山石掩映，仍能看到魔偶在周围徘徊。

say:1:1013105002:0.text: Look, there's someone in that camp!
say:1:1013105002:0.source_cn: 那片营地里好像有人！魔偶却不进去袭击，真是奇怪。

say:2:1013105003:0.text: It's quite strange that the golems aren't attacking them...
say:2:1013105003:0.source_cn: 确实，魔偶可没那么容易和人和谐共处……

say:1:1013106001:1.text: Chippy sees the emblem of the Adamant Syndicate...looks like this is a camp for their merchants!
say:1:1013106001:1.source_cn: 主人，我看到了黑金商会的徽记……看起来，这里是黑金商人...
say:1:1013106001:1.male: Chippy sees the emblem of the Adamant Syndicate...looks like this is a camp for their merchants!
say:1:1013106001:1.female: Chippy sees the emblem of the Adamant Syndicate...looks like this is a camp for their merchants!

say:3:1013106002:0.text: The Adamant Syndicate has been getting stronger lately. Do you know anything about that?
say:3:1013106002:0.source_cn: 黑金商会近些年势头很盛。看你们的样子……是否有什么我们...

choice_prompt:4:1013106002.text: The Adamant Syndicate has been getting stronger lately. Do you know anything about that?
choice_prompt:4:1013106002.source_cn: 黑金商会近些年势头很盛。看你们的样子……是否有什么我们需要知道的情况？

say:5:1013106003:3.text: They've been causing lots of trouble for the Wilders in the Dark Forest.
say:5:1013106003:3.source_cn: 他们在薄暮丛林里，对绿裔做了一些坏事。

say:7:1013106004:1.text: Dura above, how could this happen... Have the Wilders been harmed?
say:7:1013106004:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，竟然有这种事……绿裔子民们没有受到伤害吧？

say:8:1013106005:1.text: No, thankfully. The magister came in to save the day!
say:8:1013106005:1.source_cn: 好在主人阻止得及时，没有造成更大的危害！
say:8:1013106005:1.male: No, thankfully. The magister came in to save the day!
say:8:1013106005:1.female: No, thankfully. The magister came in to save the day!

say:9:1013106009:1.text: We should consider the information provided by <style="stress"><player_name></style> and proceed cautiously.
say:9:1013106009:1.male: We should consider the information provided by <style="stress"><player_name></style> and proceed cautiously.
say:9:1013106009:1.female: We should consider the information provided by <style="stress"><player_name></style> and proceed cautiously.

say:10:1013106010:2.text: Of course... I won't act recklessly. Temesia, you're always more composed than me.
say:10:1013106010:2.source_cn: 啊，当然……我不会贸然行动的。特弥希娅，你总是比我稳重。

say:12:1013106006:3.text: The Syndicate was studying some strange corruption, changing the Wilders' plants into something grotesque!
say:12:1013106006:3.source_cn: 他们好像在研究一些奇怪的污染，把绿裔的植物都改变得好恶心！

say:14:1013106007:1.text: Dura above, how could this happen?! Have the Wilder residents been affected?
say:14:1013106007:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，怎会如此？绿裔的居民们受到影响了吗？

say:15:1013106008:1.text: Don't worry! The magister helped them clear the corruption, and now the forest looks even more beautiful!
say:15:1013106008:1.source_cn: 主人帮助他们清除了污染，丛林现在更美了！
say:15:1013106008:1.male: Don't worry! The magister helped them clear the corruption, and now the forest looks even more beautiful!
say:15:1013106008:1.female: Don't worry! The magister helped them clear the corruption, and now the forest looks even more beautiful!

say:0:1013107001:0.text: You there! We have the best metal oil for your gorgeous helmet!
say:0:1013107001:0.source_cn: 这位骑士大哥，您头顶的翼冠实在亮眼！我们这有最好的金属...

say:1:1013107002:0.text: Good eye! Give me three bottles! Wait...
say:1:1013107002:0.source_cn: 眼光不错嘛，给我来三瓶——啊，好像多了点，就先来两瓶吧……

say:2:1013107003:0.text: These guys seem different from the Syndicate people from before.
say:2:1013107003:0.source_cn: 这些黑金商人和我们见过的那些黑金坏蛋，好像不太一样……

say:3:1013107004:0.text: Well, merchants are profit driven. Let's investigate more.
say:3:1013107004:0.source_cn: 商人是逐利之人，以利诱之就有道理可讲。在此处调查一番吧。
say:3:1013107004:0.male: Well, merchants are profit driven. Let's investigate more.
say:3:1013107004:0.female: Well, merchants are profit driven. Let's investigate more.

say:2:1013109001:2.text: Hey, Valen, is that you? You look even more handsome than the last time you visited.
say:2:1013109001:2.source_cn: 哟，这不是维伦先生吗？您比上次光顾时更英俊了，教教我，...

say:3:1013109002:2.text: Does that lady still like the orchid perfume you got from me last time? I've got a new jasmine perfume in stock just for you!
say:3:1013109002:2.source_cn: 怎么样？上次的依兰香水，那位小姐还中意吗？新进了茉莉的...

choice_prompt:4:1013109002.text: Does that lady still like the orchid perfume you got from me last time? I've got a new jasmine perfume in stock just for you!
choice_prompt:4:1013109002.source_cn: 怎么样？上次的依兰香水，那位小姐还中意吗？新进了茉莉的，专门给您留着——

say:5:1013109003:1.text: Of course! He's got the best wares for the ladies... Ahem. And for friends, of course!
say:5:1013109003:1.source_cn: 这个嘛，要是我只用圣石镇集市上能买到的东西送给迷人的女...

say:6:1013109004:2.text: Hey, let's discuss the perfume later. I've got some serious business today.
say:6:1013109004:2.source_cn: 喂，香水的事稍后说，我有正经差事在身。

say:7:1013109005:2.text: You've been around here for a while now. Tell me, where are those golems around the camp coming from?
say:7:1013109005:2.source_cn: 既然你在这里做生意有段时间了，那么告诉我，营地周围那些...

say:8:1013109006:2.text: If you guys are up to something fishy near Holistone that will get the general riled up—
say:8:1013109006:2.source_cn: 要是你们在圣石镇附近搞什么鬼祟的东西，惹恼了将军——

say:9:1013109007:2.text: Hey, we're just small-time traders, not connected to those scary creatures at all!
say:9:1013109007:2.source_cn: 瞧您说的！我们小生意人，怎么会跟那么可怕的怪物扯上关系？

say:10:1013109008:1.text: Ask anyone around here, we all want those golems gone! They scare off locals and travelers, ruining our business...
say:10:1013109008:1.source_cn: 您问谁都一样——我们巴不得那些魔偶消失！有他们在，附近...

say:0:1013110001:0.text: Weird, some goods here are marked "not for sale".
say:0:1013110001:0.source_cn: 好奇怪，这里的货物写着“非卖品”……主人，营地里竟然有...
say:0:1013110001:0.male: Weird, some goods here are marked "not for sale".
say:0:1013110001:0.female: Weird, some goods here are marked "not for sale".

say:0:1013111001:0.text: The magic aura here matches the one on those golems. Chippy, could you help track them down for me?
say:0:1013111001:0.source_cn: 这里和魔偶身上的魔法气息非常类似。满满，帮我追踪这些气息！
say:0:1013111001:0.male: The magic aura here matches the one on those golems. Chippy, could you help track them down for me?
say:0:1013111001:0.female: The magic aura here matches the one on those golems. Chippy, could you help track them down for me?

say:1:1013113001:1.text: Here, here! This box is super suspicious.
say:1:1013113001:1.source_cn: 呼……主人，就是这里！这个箱子，非常不对劲——
say:1:1013113001:1.male: Here, here! This box is super suspicious.
say:1:1013113001:1.female: Here, here! This box is super suspicious.

say:3:1013113002:0.text: Hey there, interested in this special box?
say:3:1013113002:0.source_cn: 哟，这位贵客！对这箱珍贵的宝物有兴趣吗？
say:3:1013113002:0.male: Hey there, interested in this special box?
say:3:1013113002:0.female: Hey there, interested in this special box?

say:4:1013113003:0.text: What makes this box so special?
say:4:1013113003:0.source_cn: 珍贵的宝物？总觉得这个形容背后有阴谋……
say:4:1013113003:0.male: What makes this box so special?
say:4:1013113003:0.female: What makes this box so special?

say:5:1013113004:0.text: Don't be mistaken, there's more than meets the eye!
say:5:1013113004:0.source_cn: 怎么会呢？贵客您有所不知，这箱东……宝物的来头可不简单！
say:5:1013113004:0.male: Don't be mistaken, there's more than meets the eye!
say:5:1013113004:0.female: Don't be mistaken, there's more than meets the eye!

say:1:1013114001:1.text: This treasure box is worth a bag of rubies, at least!
say:1:1013114001:1.source_cn: 这箱至宝珍玩，起码要一袋红宝石来换！

choice_prompt:2:1013114001.text: This treasure box is worth a bag of rubies, at least!
choice_prompt:2:1013114001.source_cn: 这箱至宝珍玩，起码要一袋红宝石来换！

say:3:1013114002:1.text: Ah-ah! There's no bargaining here in our little trade. It's a fair deal or no deal.
say:3:1013114002:1.source_cn: 小本生意，恕不还价。公平交易，愿打愿挨。

say:5:1013114003:0.text: Even the magister's negotiating skills couldn't sway this merchant. Syndicate merchants are so deceitful!
say:5:1013114003:0.source_cn: 主人要砍的价钱居然砍不下来！黑金商会、黑心奸商！
say:5:1013114003:0.male: Even the magister's negotiating skills couldn't sway this merchant. Syndicate merchants are so deceitful!
say:5:1013114003:0.female: Even the magister's negotiating skills couldn't sway this merchant. Syndicate merchants are so deceitful!

say:7:1013114006:1.text: Hey, calm down. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what's going on?
say:7:1013114006:1.male: Hey, calm down. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what's going on?
say:7:1013114006:1.female: Hey, calm down. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what's going on?

say:8:1013114007:1.text: Haggling over this box, eh? Want me to help you negotiate?
say:8:1013114007:1.source_cn: 你想买这个箱子，却谈不拢价格吗……怎么样，要不要我来交...
say:8:1013114007:1.male: Haggling over this box, eh? Want me to help you negotiate?
say:8:1013114007:1.female: Haggling over this box, eh? Want me to help you negotiate?

say:10:1013114008:2.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I've been looking for you! Any progress on the investigation?
say:10:1013114008:2.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I've been looking for you! Any progress on the investigation?
say:10:1013114008:2.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I've been looking for you! Any progress on the investigation?

say:11:1013114009:1.text: Would this box give us any of the information we need? I would like to help.
say:11:1013114009:1.source_cn: 为了取得进一步情报，最好能买下这个货箱吗？我也想出一份力。

say:13:1013114010:1.text: Magister, who are you gonna ask to negotiate for you?
say:13:1013114010:1.source_cn: 主人想让谁再交涉一番呢？
say:13:1013114010:1.male: Magister, who are you gonna ask to negotiate for you?
say:13:1013114010:1.female: Magister, who are you gonna ask to negotiate for you?

choice_prompt:14:1013114010.text: Magister, who are you gonna ask to negotiate for you?
choice_prompt:14:1013114010.source_cn: 主人想让谁再交涉一番呢？
choice_prompt:14:1013114010.male: Magister, who are you gonna ask to negotiate for you?
choice_prompt:14:1013114010.female: Magister, who are you gonna ask to negotiate for you?

say:15:1013114011:3.text: Of course! You can count on me.
say:15:1013114011:3.source_cn: 真是朴实的激将法！我承认我中招了。

say:16:1013114012:2.text: Now, good sir, regarding this box... What's the best price you can give me?
say:16:1013114012:2.source_cn: 好了。你刚才说这一箱东西多少钱？

say:17:1013114013:2.text: Mr. Valen, your friend's got great taste. This treasure box is worth this amount...
say:17:1013114013:2.source_cn: 维伦先生，您的朋友特别有眼光。这箱至宝珍玩，起码要这个数……
say:17:1013114013:2.male: Mr. Valen, your friend's got great taste. This treasure box is worth this amount...
say:17:1013114013:2.female: Mr. Valen, your friend's got great taste. This treasure box is worth this amount...

say:18:1013114014:2.text: ... Seriously? You're out of your mind!
say:18:1013114014:2.source_cn: ……你认真的吗？你这家伙的心黑透了！

narration:19:1013114015:1.text: Despite Valen's efforts, the merchant won't budge on the price, and the negotiation fails...

say:21:1013114016:3.text: I... I'll do my best. Like I do with everything.
say:21:1013114016:3.source_cn: 我……我会竭尽所能。像我做任何事一样。

say:22:1013114017:2.text: You're quite the lady. Let me tell you about the value of this special box!
say:22:1013114017:2.source_cn: 真是位英气勃勃的可爱女士。让我来给您讲讲这箱宝物的珍贵...

narration:23:1013114018:1.text: Temesia tries negotiating patiently, but was repeatedly interrupted by the merchant's slick words, and the negotiation fails...

choice:14:1:2.text: I'd rather see a Templar Knight haggle.
choice:14:1:2.source_cn: 想看看高洁的圣堂骑士讲价
choice:14:1:2.male: I'd rather see a Templar Knight haggle.
choice:14:1:2.female: I'd rather see a Templar Knight haggle.

say:24:1013114004:1.text: Magister, come now, I can't go any lower than this. Business is business.
say:24:1013114004:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人，交换就得付出代价，生意也是如此嘛。
say:24:1013114004:1.male: Magister, come now, I can't go any lower than this. Business is business.
say:24:1013114004:1.female: Magister, come now, I can't go any lower than this. Business is business.

say:26:1013114005:2.text: I misjudged you! And here I thought you were different from those other Syndicate crooks... Swindlers!
say:26:1013114005:2.source_cn: 我、我看错你们了！还以为你们跟黑金的其他坏人不一样……奸商！

choice:2:1:2.text: A whole bag? What a ripoff!
choice:2:1:2.male: A whole bag? What a ripoff!
choice:2:1:2.female: A whole bag? What a ripoff!

say:0:1013115001:0.text: Unbelievable... Perhaps he just doesn't want to sell it?
say:0:1013115001:0.source_cn: 这个世界上竟然有讲不下来的价钱……他该不会是不想卖吧？

say:1:1013115002:0.text: Well... You can't win them all.
say:1:1013115002:0.source_cn: ……常言道，女神赐给人口齿，却未必同时赐下歌喉与辩才。

say:2:1013115003:0.text: No matter, let's just keep tracking those golems' footprints.
say:2:1013115003:0.source_cn: 没关系，这实在没办法。我们继续追踪魔偶的气息前进吧。
say:2:1013115003:0.male: No matter, let's just keep tracking those golems' footprints.
say:2:1013115003:0.female: No matter, let's just keep tracking those golems' footprints.

say:0:1013116001:0.text: You guys look down... I got you guys some drinks!
say:0:1013116001:0.source_cn: 你们怎么了，看起来垂头丧气的？我给每个人都买了蜂蜜饮。

say:1:1013116002:0.text: I'm not sure what happened, but a cool drink always cheers me up!
say:1:1013116002:0.source_cn: 就是稍微有点儿浑浊，你们不会介意吧？

say:3:1013116004:0.text: Lucius, let's get ready. We're going to continue our tracking.
say:3:1013116004:0.source_cn: 卢修斯，准备出发，继续追踪魔偶。

say:0:1013117001:0.text: Their trail's becoming clearer along this path...
say:0:1013117001:0.source_cn: 这一路上，魔偶的痕迹，越来越明显了……

say:1:1013117002:0.source_cn: 要打起精神准备战斗啊。

say:2:1013117003:0.text: Let's see who defeats the most golems this time!
say:2:1013117003:0.source_cn: 比一比这次咱们谁击溃的魔偶更多，怎么样？

say:1:1013118001:1.text: Thanks for helping with the golems! My bow skills alone couldn't handle them quickly enough...
say:1:1013118001:1.source_cn: 多谢你们刚才帮忙干掉魔偶！不然凭我的弓箭，实在无法短时...

say:2:1013118002:1.text: You're travelers, right? Call me Marilee. I live close by!
say:2:1013118002:1.source_cn: 你们是旅行者吗？叫我梅瑞特就好，我就住在这附近！

say:3:1013118003:1.text: If you don't need those golem materials, could I take them off your hands?
say:3:1013118003:1.source_cn: 打个商量……如果你们不需要这些魔偶材料的话，能不能给我拿走？

say:4:1013118004:1.text: In return, I'll be your guide! And I'm good at getting any information you need!
say:4:1013118004:1.source_cn: 作为报偿，我可以做你们的向导！有什么想知道的情报，我也...

choice_prompt:5:1013118004.text: In return, I'll be your guide! And I'm good at getting any information you need!
choice_prompt:5:1013118004.source_cn: 作为报偿，我可以做你们的向导！有什么想知道的情报，我也可以帮你们打听！

say:6:1013118005:2.text: How odd. The folks around here wouldn't typically have a way to sell them...
say:6:1013118005:2.source_cn: 是啊，这附近普通的居民，应该并没有变卖它们的渠道才对……

say:7:1013118006:1.text: That was the case before the <style="highlight">Evergreen Conservatory</style> arrived here. But now, they've been gathering these materials.
say:7:1013118006:1.source_cn: 在冬青学会来到这边之前，确实是这样的。但现在，学会在收...

say:8:1013118007:1.text: We trade those materials with them in exchange for essential supplies! After all, in a situation like ours—
say:8:1013118007:1.source_cn: 只要拿给他们，就可以换来珍贵的补给！毕竟，逃难路上——

say:9:1013118008:1.text: You can never have too many resources... Especially on this long journey to the Dark Forest.
say:9:1013118008:1.source_cn: 物资多少都不嫌多……最好能撑到去薄暮丛林。

choice_prompt:10:1013118008.text: You can never have too many resources... Especially on this long journey to the Dark Forest.
choice_prompt:10:1013118008.source_cn: 物资多少都不嫌多……最好能撑到去薄暮丛林。

say:11:1013118011:1.text: With so many golems around, folks are finding it hard to survive nearby, so some are moving to the Dark Forest.
say:11:1013118011:1.source_cn: 因为魔偶太多了，大伙儿在附近不好讨生活，所以有些人搬去...

say:12:1013118012:1.text: Many may have left, but a few remain. Some will seek refuge with relatives in Holistone, while others plan to find a new home.
say:12:1013118012:1.source_cn: 虽然已经走了不少了，但还剩下一些，有的准备投奔圣石镇的...

say:14:1013118013:1.text: Did everyone get delayed due to the golem attacks?
say:14:1013118013:1.source_cn: 大家是被魔偶袭扰，才耽搁了吗？

say:15:1013118014:1.text: Yeah, you've seen it too... golems are all over the place. Everyone's too scared to be alone outdoors.
say:15:1013118014:1.source_cn: 是啊，你们也看到了……这周围魔偶很多。因为害怕，大家都...

say:16:1013118015:1.text: If only I were a bit stronger! Unfortunately, my archery skills aren't strong enough to protect everyone...
say:16:1013118015:1.source_cn: 要是我能再厉害一点就行了！可惜我的弓箭，还没强到能保护...

choice_prompt:17:1013118015.text: If only I were a bit stronger! Unfortunately, my archery skills aren't strong enough to protect everyone...
choice_prompt:17:1013118015.source_cn: 要是我能再厉害一点就行了！可惜我的弓箭，还没强到能保护所有人……

say:18:1013118016:3.text: As a member of the Heroic Order, I can't just ignore someone in need.
say:18:1013118016:3.source_cn: 身为耀光骑士团成员，既然看到了，就不能不管。

say:19:1013118017:1.text: Don't worry. Despite our appearance, we've helped loads of refugees in the Dark Forest before!
say:19:1013118017:1.source_cn: 放心。别看我们这幅样子，之前可是协助过不少在薄暮丛林避...

say:21:1013118018:1.text: Rest assured, the Templar Knights will watch over all of Dura's children—including you, Marilee.
say:21:1013118018:1.source_cn: 也请相信圣堂骑士会保护艾雅的子民们——也包括你，梅瑞特。

say:22:1013118019:1.text: You're a really good knight. Thank you, I'm counting on you all!
say:22:1013118019:1.source_cn: 你这骑士，人还怪好的嘛。我倒是不需要保护，但是大伙儿就...

choice:17:0:1.source_cn: 让我们帮忙运送材料吧

say:24:1013118020:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you don't have to tell us twice. We'll definitely step up. Right, Temesia?
say:24:1013118020:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you don't have to tell us twice. We'll definitely step up. Right, Temesia?
say:24:1013118020:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you don't have to tell us twice. We'll definitely step up. Right, Temesia?

say:26:1013118021:1.text: Rest assured, Marilee. As Templar Knights, we're here for all of Dura's children.
say:26:1013118021:1.source_cn: 请放心，梅瑞特。我们身为圣堂骑士，一定会为艾雅女神的子...

say:27:1013118022:1.source_cn: 你……你这骑士，人还怪好的嘛。

say:29:1013118023:1.text: Hey, don't forget about me! I've also helped plenty of refugees here!
say:29:1013118023:1.source_cn: 喂，也找我帮忙吧……我之前可是协助过不少在薄暮丛林避难...

choice:17:1:2.source_cn: 圣堂骑士不出手帮忙吗？

choice:5:0:1.text: Why do you need golem materials?
choice:5:0:1.male: Why do you need golem materials?
choice:5:0:1.female: Why do you need golem materials?

say:30:1013118009:1.text: Local gossip, life in the Dark Forest, locations of ruins, the Evergreen Conservatory's base...
say:30:1013118009:1.source_cn: 本地旧闻，薄暮丛林的生活，部分遗迹的地点，冬青学会的驻地……

say:31:1013118010:1.text: I'll dig up anything I can if you pay me fairly.
say:31:1013118010:1.source_cn: 只要你提供相应的报酬，我都能尽力打听。
say:31:1013118010:1.male: I'll dig up anything I can if you pay me fairly.
say:31:1013118010:1.female: I'll dig up anything I can if you pay me fairly.

choice_prompt:32:1013118010.text: I'll dig up anything I can if you pay me fairly.
choice_prompt:32:1013118010.source_cn: 只要你提供相应的报酬，我都能尽力打听。
choice_prompt:32:1013118010.male: I'll dig up anything I can if you pay me fairly.
choice_prompt:32:1013118010.female: I'll dig up anything I can if you pay me fairly.

choice:32:0:1.source_cn: 你怎么知道薄暮丛林的生活

choice:5:1:2.text: What kind of info can you find?
choice:5:1:2.male: What kind of info can you find?
choice:5:1:2.female: What kind of info can you find?

say:0:1013119001:0.text: Fantastic! The others will be so happy to have some protection.
say:0:1013119001:0.source_cn: 太棒了，你们都愿意帮忙！大家一定会很高兴的！

say:1:1013119002:0.text: Come on, I'll introduce you all!
say:1:1013119002:0.source_cn: 我领路，这就去见大家吧！

say:2:1013119003:0.text: Also, I'd love to learn some tips about fighting from you all!
say:2:1013119003:0.source_cn: 要是有战斗的机会，正好让我学上几招！

say:0:1013120001:0.text: So, piercing the golem's core can shut them down completely?
say:0:1013120001:0.source_cn: 你们是说，击穿魔偶的核心，可以彻底停止它们的行动吗？

say:1:1013120002:0.text: From what we've seen, it's a pretty effective method.
say:1:1013120002:0.source_cn: 经过我们的验证，这是比较有效的办法。
say:1:1013120002:0.male: From what we've seen, it's a pretty effective method.
say:1:1013120002:0.female: From what we've seen, it's a pretty effective method.

say:2:1013120003:0.text: Cool, I'll give that a go next time! It's a win-win.
say:2:1013120003:0.source_cn: 那太好了，我下次就这么干！这样收集的效率会越来越高。

say:3:1013120004:0.text: It helps the Evergreen Conservatory, and gets us more supplies!
say:3:1013120004:0.source_cn: 既能满足冬青学会的需要，还能获取更多的补贴，一举多得！

say:0:1013122001:0.text: Valen! I didn't think I'd run into you again! You probably don't remember me...
say:0:1013122001:0.source_cn: 你是——维伦小哥！没想到，再次见到你了！你肯定不记得我了……

say:1:1013122002:0.text: Thanks to you, things settled down in the Dark Forest for everyone...
say:1:1013122002:0.source_cn: 但我在薄暮丛林就受过你的帮助了，多亏了你，大伙在那里总...

say:1:1013123001:1.text: I've returned to get my family. If it weren't for you, we wouldn't have known what to do.
say:1:1013123001:1.source_cn: 这次我是回来接家人的，要不是遇到了你，我们全家真不知道...

say:2:1013123002:2.text: I did what I could. But what's your family doing here?
say:2:1013123002:2.source_cn: 我只是力所能及地做了一些小事而已，倒是你，你的家人怎么...

say:3:1013123003:1.text: The golems didn't cause this. After our home was destroyed, all we could do was try to find a new place to live. Some people went to Holistone...
say:3:1013123003:1.source_cn: 还不是魔偶闹的，家里被破坏后，我们只能四处寻找新的定居...

say:4:1013123004:1.text: Others went to Ryeham, but we had nowhere to turn, and it's not like we could go overseas with children and the elderly... Luckily, Maria's family took them in!
say:4:1013123004:1.source_cn: 有的人去了金穗村，我们家无依无靠，又不能带着老人孩子飘...

say:5:1013123005:1.text: She even dropped off some supplies now and then, seeing as everyone moved to Holistone. We may have met with misfortune, but we also met many good people. Including you, Valen!
say:5:1013123005:1.source_cn: 甚至还因为大伙搬去了圣石镇，偶尔送点物资过来。虽然我们...

say:6:1013123006:1.text: Any knight with a conscience would have done the same thing...
say:6:1013123006:1.source_cn: 有点良心的骑士，在当时的情况下，都会作出和我相同的选择……

say:8:1013123007:1.text: *Laughter* Look at Valen, lost for words after being genuinely thanked.
say:8:1013123007:1.source_cn: 哼哼！想不到维伦这种平时优哉游哉的家伙，被真心感谢了反...

say:9:1013123008:1.text: I'm not being shy, Hammie. It just feels a bit... undeserved.
say:9:1013123008:1.source_cn: 别把我说得这么可爱啊，漫漫小姐。只是觉得……多少受之有愧吧。

say:10:1013123009:2.text: The one who made the biggest difference was <style="stress"><player_name></style> here.
say:10:1013123009:2.source_cn: ……真正改变局面的人，是我们的<style=stres...
say:10:1013123009:2.male: The one who made the biggest difference was <style="stress"><player_name></style> here.
say:10:1013123009:2.female: The one who made the biggest difference was <style="stress"><player_name></style> here.

say:11:1013123010:1.text: He's the one who sorted out the exclusion edict, making the Dark Forest welcoming to refugees again. If anyone deserves thanks, it's him.
say:11:1013123010:1.source_cn: 解决了封锁令，让薄暮丛林重新开始接收难民——如果有谁值...
say:11:1013123010:1.male: He's the one who sorted out the exclusion edict, making the Dark Forest welcoming to refugees again. If anyone deserves thanks, it's him.
say:11:1013123010:1.female: She's the one who sorted out the exclusion edict, making the Dark Forest welcoming to refugees again. If anyone deserves thanks, it's her.

say:13:1013123011:1.text: Seems we owe you for giving us a place to go!
say:13:1013123011:1.source_cn: 解决了封锁令？还做到了那种事？看来大家能有去处，都是拜...
say:13:1013123011:1.male: Seems we owe you for giving us a place to go!
say:13:1013123011:1.female: Seems we owe you for giving us a place to go!

say:15:1013123012:1.text: Dura above, we really can't thank you enough. Seriously, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you saved our lives!
say:15:1013123012:1.source_cn: 艾雅女神在上，我们实在无以言谢……不夸张地说，<sty...
say:15:1013123012:1.male: Dura above, we really can't thank you enough. Seriously, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you saved our lives!
say:15:1013123012:1.female: Dura above, we really can't thank you enough. Seriously, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you saved our lives!

choice_prompt:16:1013123012.text: Dura above, we really can't thank you enough. Seriously, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you saved our lives!
choice_prompt:16:1013123012.source_cn: 艾雅女神在上，我们实在无以言谢……不夸张地说，<style=stress><player_name></style>大人，您拯救了我们的生命！
choice_prompt:16:1013123012.male: Dura above, we really can't thank you enough. Seriously, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you saved our lives!
choice_prompt:16:1013123012.female: Dura above, we really can't thank you enough. Seriously, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you saved our lives!

say:17:1013123013:1.text: It seems the rumors were true; you're truly a kind and capable magister!
say:17:1013123013:1.source_cn: 和传闻印证了，您果然是善良又有能力的魔法师！
say:17:1013123013:1.male: It seems the rumors were true; you're truly a kind and capable magister!
say:17:1013123013:1.female: It seems the rumors were true; you're truly a kind and capable magister!

say:18:1013123014:1.text: It's as they say, true heroes stay humble. I'll be sure to spread your heroic deeds to everyone!
say:18:1013123014:1.source_cn: 真正的英雄都是谦逊的，我会将您的事迹传颂给大伙儿！
say:18:1013123014:1.male: It's as they say, true heroes stay humble. I'll be sure to spread your heroic deeds to everyone!
say:18:1013123014:1.female: It's as they say, true heroes stay humble. I'll be sure to spread your heroic deeds to everyone!

choice:16:0:1.text: There's no need to thank me.
choice:16:0:1.male: There's no need to thank me.
choice:16:0:1.female: There's no need to thank me.

say:0:1013124001:0.text: No matter how the magister's identity changes, he's still the most powerful magister!
say:0:1013124001:0.source_cn: 这位男性真是有眼光！果然，无论主人的身份如何变化……都...
say:0:1013124001:0.male: No matter how the magister's identity changes, he's still the most powerful magister!
say:0:1013124001:0.female: No matter how the magister's identity changes, she's still the most powerful magister!

say:1:1013124002:0.text: Huh? What do you mean, <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s identity?
say:1:1013124002:0.male: Huh? What do you mean, <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s identity?
say:1:1013124002:0.female: Huh? What do you mean, <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s identity?

say:2:1013124003:0.text: You guys really are an odd group, but I won't question it...
say:2:1013124003:0.source_cn: 卢修斯，总是忠诚，必要时缄默。

say:1:1013125001:0.text: Well, we've hit the jackpot this time! We can trade these in for supplies!
say:1:1013125001:0.source_cn: 嗯，这次的收获很大！可以拿去换补给咯！

say:2:1013125002:0.text: Hey, Marilee, do you know why the Evergreen Conservatory is gathering these materials?
say:2:1013125002:0.source_cn: 梅瑞特小姐，你知道冬青学会收集这些材料的目的吗？

say:3:1013125003:0.text: Um, it seems they're into golem research and stuff...
say:3:1013125003:0.source_cn: 唔，她们要搞什么魔偶研究吧，还有一些其他的研究……

say:4:1013125004:2.text: Kinda lines up with our goals. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, should we check it out?
say:4:1013125004:2.source_cn: 这倒是跟我们的目的有些一致，<style=stress...
say:4:1013125004:2.male: Kinda lines up with our goals. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, should we check it out?
say:4:1013125004:2.female: Kinda lines up with our goals. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, should we check it out?

choice_prompt:5:1013125004.text: Kinda lines up with our goals. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, should we check it out?
choice_prompt:5:1013125004.source_cn: 这倒是跟我们的目的有些一致，<style=stress><player_name></style>大人，我们要去看看吗？
choice_prompt:5:1013125004.male: Kinda lines up with our goals. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, should we check it out?
choice_prompt:5:1013125004.female: Kinda lines up with our goals. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, should we check it out?

say:6:1013125005:2.text: Wanna go together? I'll introduce you, and you can ask about the golems!
say:6:1013125005:2.source_cn: 要不要一起去？我介绍你们认识，你们想知道魔偶的事，尽可...

say:8:1013125008:0.text: Thank you, Marilee. I hope the Evergreen Conservatory has enough information on the golems...
say:8:1013125008:0.source_cn: 梅瑞特小姐，多谢你。希望我们能在冬青学会得到魔偶的足够...

say:9:1013125009:2.text: Ahem! Miss knight, could you not stare at me with those adorable eyes?
say:9:1013125009:2.source_cn: 咳咳！这位英气勃勃的骑士，你别用那双可爱的眼睛看着我行吗？

say:10:1013125010:2.text: I'm a little nervous to ask you guys a favor now...
say:10:1013125010:2.source_cn: 你这么认真，搞得我都不好意思提条件了……

say:11:1013125011:1.text: I really wanted to ask if you could also help me bring these golem materials back home?
say:11:1013125011:1.source_cn: 本来还想请诸位辛苦一下，再次帮我运送这些魔偶材料回家的...

say:12:1013125012:2.text: Don't worry, Temesia's really a softie on the inside!

say:13:1013125013:1.text: Apologies, I've been told I have an intimidating look.
say:13:1013125013:1.source_cn: 是吗。我不太明白刚才的言行哪里为你带来了困扰……

say:14:1013125014:1.text: But your request is reasonable. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think?
say:14:1013125014:1.male: But your request is reasonable. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think?
say:14:1013125014:1.female: But your request is reasonable. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think?

choice_prompt:15:1013125014.text: But your request is reasonable. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think?
choice_prompt:15:1013125014.source_cn: 但你的要求完全合理。<style=stress><player_name></style>大人，你的意见呢？
choice_prompt:15:1013125014.male: But your request is reasonable. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think?
choice_prompt:15:1013125014.female: But your request is reasonable. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think?

say:16:1013125015:1.source_cn: 好耶！那就拜托诸位啦，多谢多谢！

choice:5:0:1.text: Hmm, that might be a good idea.
choice:5:0:1.male: Hmm, that might be a good idea.
choice:5:0:1.female: Hmm, that might be a good idea.

say:19:1013125007:2.text: I know some folks there, they can get you the info you need!
say:19:1013125007:2.source_cn: 我在那里还有几个熟人，一定能问出结果！

say:0:1013126001:0.text: My place is close! My grandma's treats are awesome, you gotta try them!
say:0:1013126001:0.source_cn: 我的家很近的！我的奶奶会做很好吃的点心！请务必品尝一番！

say:1:1013126002:0.text: There's a spring nearby; the tea brewed from its water is amazing!
say:1:1013126002:0.source_cn: 周围还有一处泉眼，泉水泡的茶也非常清甜！

say:0:1013127001:0.source_cn: 这些材料，确实有点重量……

say:1:1013127002:0.text: Exactly, I couldn't have done this without you guys!
say:1:1013127002:0.source_cn: 是吧，不然我也不会拜托各位！

say:2:1013127003:0.text: No worries, helping out is a knight's duty!
say:2:1013127003:0.source_cn: 没关系，扶危救苦是圣骑士的职责所在！

say:3:1013127004:0.text: That's true. Why don't you also help with my haul then?
say:3:1013127004:0.source_cn: 很有道理，那你就再拿着我这份吧。

say:4:1013127005:0.text: You're a knight as well, don't run away!
say:4:1013127005:0.source_cn: 你好歹也是骑士啊，别跑……

say:1:1013128001:0.text: Is Marilee's home around here? When visiting a lady's residence, one's gotta be polite.
say:1:1013128001:0.source_cn: 梅瑞特小姐的家，就在这里吗？拜访女性的住所，看来我得保...

say:3:1013128002:0.text: Sis brought home a strange boy! This has never happened before, could it be...?
say:3:1013128002:0.source_cn: 姐姐带了陌生的男孩子回来了！从来没有这种事，难道……

say:4:1013128003:0.text: I see! He's the bear sis caught and mercifully released, and now he's turned into a human to repay her!
say:4:1013128003:0.source_cn: 我知道了！他是被姐姐射中又放走的小棕熊，现在变成人形来...

say:5:1013128004:1.text: ... Wait, why a bear? I could definitely be a cooler animal!
say:5:1013128004:1.source_cn: ……等等，为什么是小棕熊？没有更帅气的动物吗？

say:7:1013128005:0.text: Gosh! You two, stop teasing my guests. Where are Grandpa and Grandma?
say:7:1013128005:0.source_cn: 喂！你们两个，别闹我的客人们。爷爷奶奶呢？

say:8:1013128006:0.text: The street lamp broke earlier! Grandpa's fixing it and Grandma's holding the ladder...
say:8:1013128006:0.source_cn: 之前后面的路灯坏掉了，爷爷去修灯了，奶奶给他扶梯子……

say:2:1013131001:1.text: Didn't I tell you not to worry? What if something happens to you?!
say:2:1013131001:1.source_cn: 我、我不是说了让你们俩别操心的吗？要是有个万一，你们让...

say:3:1013131002:1.text: It's my fault... I'm always out all day, I can't properly take care of you guys.
say:3:1013131002:1.source_cn: 对不起，是我整天在外面跑，有太多照顾不到的地方……

say:4:1013131003:2.text: Oh, kiddo. Without you helping the Evergreen Conservatory, we'd have no food.
say:4:1013131003:2.source_cn: 好孩子，要不是你在外面帮冬青学会干活，咱们一家人的口粮...

say:5:1013131004:1.text: Our previous home was attacked by golems, so we moved here for safety...
say:5:1013131004:1.source_cn: 之前住的地方总被魔偶骚扰，也是为了我们能住得安全，才搬...

say:6:1013131005:1.text: Since we came here, you've never brought friends over. Who might these people be?
say:6:1013131005:1.source_cn: 自从来这里之后，你还从没带朋友回来过呢。好多年轻人啊……

say:7:1013131006:2.text: Grandma can't see well; are they your hunting pals?
say:7:1013131006:2.source_cn: 奶奶看不清，是跟你一起打猎的朋友吗？

choice_prompt:8:1013131006.text: Grandma can't see well; are they your hunting pals?
choice_prompt:8:1013131006.source_cn: 奶奶看不清，是跟你一起打猎的朋友吗？

say:9:1013131007:1.text: Not yet, at least! These people are powerful magisters and knights who have helped tons of people!
say:9:1013131007:1.source_cn: 还不是呢。他们是很强大的魔法师和骑士，帮助过很多人……
say:9:1013131007:1.male: Not yet, at least! These people are powerful magisters and knights who have helped tons of people!
say:9:1013131007:1.female: Not yet, at least! These people are powerful magisters and knights who have helped tons of people!

say:10:1013131008:1.text: And hopefully we'll be closer someday!
say:10:1013131008:1.source_cn: 如果哪天能成为朋友，就太好了！

say:11:1013131010:1.text: Ah, I nearly forgot. I'll get you guys some tea and snacks!
say:11:1013131010:1.source_cn: 啊，差点忘了正经事。请用些茶水和食物吧！

say:12:1013131011:1.text: Once we're rested, let's head to the Evergreen Conservatory camp.
say:12:1013131011:1.source_cn: 等休息好了，再往冬青学会营地进发吧。

narration:14:1013131012:0.text: At Marilee's place, everyone got a warm welcome and a good meal.
narration:14:1013131012:0.source_cn: 大家受到了梅瑞特家人的热情招待，在此饱餐了一顿。

say:16:1013131009:1.text: Even though you may not stay here for long... it would be wonderful if we were friends!
say:16:1013131009:1.source_cn: 没错，是刚刚认识的新朋友！虽然你们应该不会在这里久留…...

cinematic_dialogue:1:1035101001:.text: Rare supplies! Get them before we sell out!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1035109002:.text: My goods are of the highest quality!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1035101002:.text: I don't get it. Why are the higher-ups making it hard for us?
cinematic_dialogue:1:1035101002:.source_cn: 真是搞不懂，上层的要求是为难人吗？

cinematic_dialogue:1:1035102001:.text: Is this year's shipment going to get crushed again?
cinematic_dialogue:1:1035102001:.source_cn: 难道今年的货又要压箱底了吗？

cinematic_dialogue:1:1035101003:.text: What can we do if the golems come? We've already lost a lot.
cinematic_dialogue:1:1035101003:.source_cn: 魔偶要是进来该怎么办？已经亏很多了
